name: Account Needle
description: Thread a needle of owed harm through the guard to the exact spot the foe once wounded.

name: Final Lien
description: Lay a final lien on the foe's qi that grows heavier the more they struggle.

name: Tallied Aegis
description: Raise a wall that stands for each blow already paid and breaks only for the unpaid.

name: Debt Purge
description: Take a curse of owed harm off an ally by paying its weight from the user's own merit.

name: Account Spear
description: Drive a spear of owed harm through the foe in the exact measure of the wrongs they have done.

name: Account Wave
description: Roll a wave over the field that falls on each foe by the sum of their own deeds.

name: Lien Fortress
description: Stand a fortress of liens round the user that gives back every strike in its own kind.

name: Merit Revival
description: Pay one ally's last breath from the user's stored merit within a short window; it never returns the long dead.

name: Full Requital
description: Return the whole of a great harm to its doer in full measure past every guard.

name: Account Writ
description: Seal the foe's working of qi under a debt they must clear before it can be freed.

name: Last Weight
description: Drop the last and heaviest weight of a foe's deeds upon them and keep it pressing.

name: Account Closed
description: Close the school's account over the field and bind and strike each debtor by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Debt Calamity
description: Call every debt of every foe in the field due at once; the scale is the destructive ceiling of a Xiantian cultivator.

name: Reckon Needle
description: Pin a foe with a needle fired from the Core and sized to their worst deed.

name: Core Writ
description: Serve a writ from the Core that shuts a foe's technique until the debt is cleared.

name: Reckoned Shield
description: Raise a wall from the Core whose strength is set by the harm done to the user.

name: Core Absolution
description: Absolve an ally of a lingering curse by drawing its weight into the Core.

name: Reckon Spear
description: Hurl a spear from the Core that strikes with the sum of the foe's deeds.

name: Reckon Flood
description: Flood the ground with owed harm so that every foe in it is struck by what they owe.

name: Mirrored Aegis
description: Hold a bastion that mirrors the harm of each blow back to the one who struck.

name: Merit Mend
description: Pay an ally's grave wounds from the Core's stored merit and close them over time.

name: Complete Return
description: Give back every harm of a long fight at once and past all guard in a single answer.

name: Moment Phase
description: Slip out of the chain of cause so that a blow aimed at the user finds no body to strike.

name: Debt Absorb
description: Take a heavy blow into the Core as a debt to be returned and hold its weight for later.

name: Core Reckoning
description: Cast the school's reckoning from the Core and strike and weigh down all foes by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Reckoning Day
description: Weigh the whole of every foe's life and answer it in a single stroke; the scale is the destructive ceiling of a Core Formation cultivator.
